symptom: The selective opening guard that passed the 3 seed high-pressure no-regression probe did not scale to a 10 seed caramel-workshop target follow-up. Against the per-map edge branch plus all-map late filter baseline, both baseline and candidate recorded 0.1 win rate, but the candidate average survival dropped from 242.8409s to 238.65s. The fixed-window validator reported policy_window_regression_failed with a 300s/caramel-workshop survival blocker of -4.1909s.
root_cause: The repair is currently seed-local rather than broadly robust. The candidate converts seed 63402 from player_health_depleted at 245.2901s to duration_reached at 300.0150s, but it loses baseline's previous seed 63407 victory, dropping that seed from duration_reached at 300.0150s to player_health_depleted at 231.0204s. This indicates the terminal-sequence checkpoint and selective opening guard shift the winning trajectory between seeds instead of improving the target distribution.
fix: Do not promote the selective opening guard beyond repair evidence. The low-health-only and 180s late-only health-retention probes failed to rescue seed 63407, while the 60-300s mid-path retention probe restored seed 63407 and passed the 10 seed caramel target no-regression follow-up. Keep this as target-specific repair evidence only; the next real fix should convert the 60-180s path-retention signal into a trained constrained objective, then rerun 10 seed target follow-up and 60/180/300s high-pressure no-regression.
validation: Ran baseline_caramel_300s_10seed.json and candidate_caramel_300s_10seed.json for caramel-workshop seeds 63400-63409 at 300s. After adding single-map report support to validate_policy_window_regression.py, reran window_regression_caramel_300s_10seed.json and recorded decision policy_window_regression_failed with one survival blocker. Reran the candidate with --trace-failed-only and saved 9 failed seed traces under candidate_failed_traces/. Then captured candidate seed 63402 success and baseline seed 63407 success traces, compared baseline_success_63407 against candidate_regression_63407, and confirmed the regression reaches low health at 226.0193s while the baseline reaches 300s without low-health trace evidence. Follow-up health-retention diagnostics rejected the 180-300s low-health-only guard and the 180-300s late-only path retention, but accepted the 60-300s mid-path retention as repair evidence: it restored seed 63407 to duration_reached at 300.0150s, raised the 10 seed target follow-up win rate from 0.1 to 0.2, improved average survival from 242.8409s to 245.5495s, and passed window_regression_caramel_300s_10seed with 0 blockers. The high-pressure 60/180/300s follow-up also passed against the per-map chain baseline with 0 blockers, while noting that seed 63407 is outside the 63400-63402 high-pressure window.
